name: Vizier Eknet
description: An aven vizier of the Hekma Guard who repairs the barrier and is bluffed by Jace.

description_citations.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: An aven vizier arrives to repair the barrier and questions their strange clothes; Jace reads his mind and bluffs a cover story about a faraway district.
timeline.quote: Well, of course, that's why I'm here in the . . . Nitin district, to teach you.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.
